entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A half-elven planeswalker from a bygone era and leader of elven clans who sacrificed her life to save her people.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane threatened by a catastrophe that Freyalise prevented.

events.summary: Freyalise uses her power to protect her elven clans' forest home.
events.quote: Freyalise was a leader of elven clans who used her incredible power to protect their forest home.

events.summary: Freyalise sacrifices her life to save her people, preventing a catastrophe that threatened to destroy Dominaria.
events.quote: She heroically sacrificed her life to save her people and prevented a catastrophe that threatened to destroy Dominaria.
